I frequently forget what packages I want to install in a new project, especially if it's something new that I haven't gotten in the habit of using regularly.
So here, I'm going to keep track of packages I install, and why.

- milesmcbain/tflow: helps greatly in setting up and managing targets workflows
- milesmcbain/paint: turns data-frames 90 degrees, and color codes the output
- lpembleton/corner: makes viewing data-frames and matrices much nicer in the console
- bioconductor/SummarizedExperiment: if I'm working with -omics abundance data, I need this. Mainline it into my veins.
- cran/targets & tarchetypes: targets pipelines. If I'm doing analyses, I need these to keep it sane.
- rmflight/flighttools: helper functions, and notifications, oh my.
- moseleybioinformaticslab/ICIKendallTau: doing correlations.
- moseleybioinformaticslab/visualizationQualityControl: doing qc/qa stuff.
- cran/visdat: missingness visualization, generally useful.
